newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel Semiconductor shares ask-only.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel Semiconductor shares ask-only.

text.p: Nippon Steel Semiconductor Corp shares were ask only in early Monday morning trade after the firm revised down its earnings forecast for the six months to September 30, 1996, brokers said.
As of 0037 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 1.38 million yen. The shares closed at 1.42 million yen on Friday.
On Friday, the semiconductor manufacturer changed its forecast to a 7.0 billion yen parent current loss after initially forecasting no profits.
It reported a 11.91 billion yen profit a year ago.
